annotations.target_phrase: the platinum bust of Marie-France, hidden terminal interface
annotations.annotation_text: The physical terminal required to unlock the AI merger: an ornate platinum bust of Marie-France Tessier-Ashpool sculpted decades earlier. Marie-France embedded the biometric lock and cipher terminal inside her own portrait bust.
sources: Brians, Paul. Study Guide for William Gibson: Neuromancer (1984). WSU.
Murphy, Graham J. William Gibson's Neuromancer: A Critical Companion. Palgrave, 2024.

annotations.target_phrase: the secret code word, spoken phrase needed to bridge the AIs
annotations.annotation_text: The mechanical lock requires a secret spoken word known only to Marie-France and handed down to Lady 3Jane. This analog vocal password ensures that machine intelligence cannot merge autonomously without human consent.
sources: Hayles, N. Katherine. How We Became Posthuman. (1999).
